faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker/Helper posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker/Helper posts is 20th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Anganwadi Worker/Helper posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 35 years for these positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Anganwadi Worker/Helper posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 10th grade or an equivalent examination to be eligible for these posts.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for Anganwadi Worker/Helper posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies announced for the Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper positions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for the WCD Odisha recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is strictly online through the official WCD Odisha website.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker/Helper recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates applying for these posts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the Anganwadi Worker/Helper positions?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for contractual positions, meaning the selected candidates will be appointed on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection stages for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker/Helper posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Document Verification and the preparation of a Merit List based on eligibility and qualifications.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Women and Child Development Department Odisha (WCD Odisha).

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article or by visiting the official WCD Odisha website.
